Verify approved records and their lineage. A blockchain entry does not create legal authority or establish that a payment occurred.
Reconstruction note: consolidated the screenshot’s repeated stage 9; corrected text artifacts and clarified expiration versus cancellation.
Process: OMB Circular A–11 (2025), §§10, 20, 120; GAO budget definitions. Blockchain placement is a design proposal.
